args.sql:
WITH max_light_sensitivity AS (
    SELECT 
        artref, 
        MAX(lightlux) AS max_light_lux
    FROM 
        lightandradiationreadings
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments ON lightandradiationreadings.lightradregistry = conditionassessments.lightreadrefobserved
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore ON lightandradiationreadings.envreadref = environmentalreadingscore.envreadregistry
    GROUP BY 
        artref
),
artifact_info AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry, 
        artname, 
        mattype, 
        lightsensitivity
    FROM 
        artifactscore
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata ON artifactscore.artregistry = sensitivitydata.artref
)
SELECT 
    ai.artregistry AS registry_number,
    ai.artname AS name,
    ai.mattype AS material_type,
    ai.lightsensitivity AS light_sensitivity,
    CASE 
        WHEN mls.max_light_lux > 1000 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS current_status
FROM 
    artifact_info ai
LEFT JOIN 
    max_light_sensitivity mls ON ai.artregistry = mls.artref;

events.sql:
WITH max_light_sensitivity AS (
    SELECT 
        artref, 
        MAX(lightlux) AS max_light_lux
    FROM 
        lightandradiationreadings
    JOIN 
        conditionassessments ON lightandradiationreadings.lightradregistry = conditionassessments.lightreadrefobserved
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore ON lightandradiationreadings.envreadref = environmentalreadingscore.envreadregistry
    GROUP BY 
        artref
),
artifact_info AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry, 
        artname, 
        mattype, 
        lightsensitivity
    FROM 
        artifactscore
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata ON artifactscore.artregistry = sensitivitydata.artref
)
SELECT 
    ai.artregistry AS registry_number,
    ai.artname AS name,
    ai.mattype AS material_type,
    ai.lightsensitivity AS light_sensitivity,
    CASE 
        WHEN mls.max_light_lux > 1000 THEN 'Over Exposure'
        ELSE 'Within Limits'
    END AS current_status
FROM 
    artifact_info ai
LEFT JOIN 
    max_light_sensitivity mls ON ai.artregistry = mls.artref;
